messages:
Alex: weekend recs — family in town, need two things: a movie (90s sci-fi vibe) and a chill dinner playlist. hit me with your best stuff. :popcorn:

Maria: if you want 90s sci-fi, watch 'Dark City' or 'Gattaca' — Dark City is weirder, Gattaca is cleaner. :nerd_face:

Jeff: for dinner playlist, I usually throw on my 'Bedtime Indie' playlist on Spotify — search 'bedtime indie jeff' or use the share link: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9... (shortlink, will paste full later)

Sophia: also 'The Expanse' S1 is a great longer binge if you want serial TV instead of a movie. lightweight sci + politics.

Nate: +1 Gattaca. also suggest 'Primer' if you want a heady, low-budget timey-wimey thing. not for everyone but memorable.

Ellie: book rec: 'Recursion' by Blake Crouch if you want mind-bendy scifi in book form. perfect train read.

Jeff: quick podcast recs for car rides: 'Criminal' or 'Someone Knows Something' — short, well-produced eps.

Alex: solid. quick poll — movie tonight? 1) Dark City 2) Gattaca 3) Primer

Maria: 2

Sophia: 1

Nate: 3

Ellie: 2

Jeff: 2 :thumbsup:

Alex: ok it's GATTACA. @Jeff can you drop the playlist + a slow-songs mini-curation for dinner?

Jeff: dropping playlist + tiny curated slow set:
```
https://open.spotify.com/playlist/slow-dinner (curated)
Highlights: The National - 'I Need My Girl', Cigarettes After Sex - 'K.', Sufjan - 'Mystery of Love'
```

mux-bot: Reminder: Virtual movie night poll created — sign up here: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/xyz

Alex: perfect. movie at 7pm. who volunteers to bring popcorn? :popcorn:

Ellie: i'll bring popcorn :raised_hands:

Nate: i'll bring the terrible movie snacks (hot Cheetos)

Sophia: i'll bring vibes :sparkles:

Jeff: awesome mix. see you all tonight.

Maria: if anyone wants a 90s sci soundtrack afterwards, i've got a mixtape. :)
